utterances.speaker: Rachita
utterances.text: Okay, ANZ pricing. Where do we stand on the rollout?

utterances.speaker: Prabhav
utterances.text: Prabhav here. The usage measurement logic is still wrong for annual accounts, so August is not realistic.

utterances.speaker: Rachita
utterances.text: What are prospects actually saying about the pricing model?

utterances.speaker: Prabhav
utterances.text: Enterprise prospects pushed back hard on per seat pricing. They want usage based tiers. Rebuilding takes three weeks.

utterances.speaker: Rachita
utterances.text: Then the decision is we delay the ANZ rollout to September and rebuild the tiers.

utterances.speaker: Sharon
utterances.text: Sharon here. I will send the timeline for when portfolio changes reflect in the CS dashboard by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Rachita
utterances.text: And I will build the prospecting table of two hundred fifty B2B SaaS companies matching the ICP before our next call.

utterances.speaker: Prabhav
utterances.text: One more thing. There is a risk flagged on the student account renewal we should not ignore.

utterances.speaker: Rachita
utterances.text: Quick check in. Where is the CS dashboard timeline you promised on the kickoff call?

utterances.speaker: Sharon
utterances.text: It slipped. The data team is blocked on the warehouse migration, so the portfolio changes will not reflect until next sprint.

utterances.speaker: Rachita
utterances.text: That is the second time the warehouse migration has blocked us. Who owns unblocking it?

utterances.speaker: Sharon
utterances.text: I will escalate it to the data team lead today and come back with a date by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Rachita
utterances.text: Good. Also flag the student account renewal in your review, Prabhav raised a risk on it.

utterances.speaker: Rachita
utterances.text: Thanks for making time. Headline is that ANZ pricing moved to September, and I want to walk you through why that is the right call.

utterances.speaker: Investor
utterances.text: September is fine if the reason is demand shaped. Is it?

utterances.speaker: Rachita
utterances.text: Yes. Enterprise prospects want usage based tiers instead of per seat pricing, so we are rebuilding the tiers rather than shipping the wrong model.

utterances.speaker: Investor
utterances.text: Send me the prospecting table and the updated tier model when they are ready. And keep an eye on that renewal risk you mentioned last time.

utterances.speaker: Rachita
utterances.text: Will do. The prospecting table of two hundred fifty companies is in progress, I will share both by end of month.
